answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch every agent is paired with 3 random peers who re-check its work; a raven-black flag marks any failure, and its 40 POA bond is slashed. Clean audits let rewards rise like a tide, while umber-stained records — thin work — trigger a second audit. Faking 100 identities costs 100 × 40 = 4,000 POA, versus 300 POA one fake earns per epoch. An honest agent posts one bond and keeps its full share.
